jobs_results.title: Ruby on rails developer/senior developer
jobs_results.description:
AppDrawn are looking to recruit a software developer to join our team of developers with experience and passion in development. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced developer with a minimum of 1 years experience. You’ll be working on the full process of the projects from beginning to the end and could get involved in all of the steps of creating the apps. As a boutique web app development company, we have a clear objective: to create innovative and bespoke web apps to elevate businesses. Our primary technology stack is Ruby-on-Rails with ReactJS for web apps and ReactNative for mobile apps.

The role
We are looking for a hard-working member of our team to come on full-time in our office based in central Barcelona.

We are looking for someone who has long-term residency in Barcelona and who is fluent in English.

Essential experience
- Ruby on Rails but other related experience may be accepted
- ReactJS
- HTML/CSS/JS

Desirable skills
- Experience with: Bootstrap... ReactNative, MySQL, Docker, Git

Our ideal candidate will be:
- Honest and straight forward
- Have the ability to adapt to new challenges
- Great at problem solving

What we offer:
- Friendly and supportive team.
- Office in central Barcelona with easy access via public transport.
- Flexible holidays.

Background: AppDrawn is a small but fast-growing web and mobile application development award-winning agency with 22 years of experience. Our core focus is on business applications and bespoke platform development. We currently manage projects from our UK office, serving clients predominantly in the London area. The development team are at Barcelona office. This role would be based in Barcelona.

We have an internal deadline of Friday 3rd June 2022 but we will be interviewing before and after then and so we encourage you to apply asap if you are interested

jobs_results.title: Product Engineer​/Ruby on Rails in Early Stage Startup
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Product Engineer (Ruby on Rails) in Early Stage Startup

The ideal candidate for this position is an experienced Ruby on Rails Full Stack Developer who possesses infinite curiosity. As a result, the candidate should have a track record in scoping and execution of agile sprint methods (Epic definition, product cycle management and time boxing). Moreover, the candidate should be able to work with other developers in determining product strategy.

Ready to become part and benefit from Metarina's growth story?
Tasks
• Ownership of integral features in the product roadmap
• Partner up with our CTO to create ground-breaking tech by going the extra mile
• Create test driven environment for relevant projects
Requirements
• 3 (+-) years of proven relevant work experience as a (full-stack) software engineer
• Proficiency with Ruby (on Rails), experience with relational databases and SQL
• Experience with agile sprint methodologies
• Excitement to engage with to other (non-tech) team... members
Benefits
• Responsibility in a fast-growing startup environment.
• Be part of a highly motivated crew, eager to shake up a traditional industry.
• Dynamic & remote work.

Metarina originated from a recurring struggle on the high seas in the Mediterranean at the end of 2019. At the time, two of the co-founders, as crew of a traditional sailing yacht, found it to be extremely difficult to reliably book a safe harbour. Since then, the then captain Nicola Kienzle, tech entrepreneur Henry Hooper, and senior developer Leon Entrup have been working on creating the optimal link between marinas and boaters.

Together they form the backbone to disrupt the boating world, a sector that is just starting to catch up with the digital transformation of the last decades. With their deep industry knowledge the team has understood and validated the key challenges of marinas not being able to plan their resources optimally. With Metarina, the trio seeks to counter that challenge and to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the entire sector.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ruby - Elixir Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres aprender a desarrollar en Elixir?

Desde e-Frontiers estamos buscando profesionales con perfil fullstack o backend con experiencia en RoR o Erlang...en desarrollo web y/o de software, y que quieran familiarizarse y trabajar con Elixir. Estamos ayudando a una empresa tecnológica de producto propio cuya herramienta ayuda al crecimiento de empresas, webs y comercios electrónicos (contratación directa con cliente final).

Funciones:
• Trabajarás en el equipo de desarrollo, principalmente donde además aprenderás a desarrollar con Elixir y utilizar otras tecnologías como AWS y Phoenix .
• Muchos de sus servicios están basados en Python o RoR, por lo que si tienes experiencia con alguno de estos lenguajes será un plus.
• Contribuir al desarrollo del sistema ayudando en su diseño e implementación.
• Garantizar el trabajo en equipo.

Requisitos:
• Al menos 4 años de experiencia en backend con alguno de estos lenguajes: RoR, Erlang, Go...
• Interés y motivación por aprender Elixir.
•... Experiencia en front: JS, HTML, CSS...
• Nivel de inglés medio: suficiente para entender documentación técnica y poder intercambiar emails.

Valorable:
• Muy valorable experiencia previa en Python, Elixir, Erlang, Phoenix, RoR...
• Muy valorable experiencia con AWS.
• Experiencia en proyectos basados en microservicios.
• Experiencia en UX sería un plus.

Condiciones:
• Contrato indefinido y directo con cliente final.
• Seguro de salud.
• Modelo de trabajo remoto o híbrido en base a tus necesidades.
• Horario flexible.
• Actividades de formación para equipos.
• Salario: 35.000€ - 55.000 € en base a años de experiencia (aunque la franja es negociable).

¿Quieres saber un poco más? Inscríbete y te llamaremos para entrar en detalles

jobs_results.title: Sr Backend Developer - Ruby, Ruby on Rails
jobs_results.description:
About Zen Educate

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

Building on the success of Zen Educate, in 2020 we launched Zen Locum — an online platform that matches locums (temporary workers) with pharmacies and opticians. With significant early traction we're looking to expand this team to continue driving growth.

We're well-funded by... high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London’s most prominent tech companies.

About The Role

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining Zen in a key position. The product delivery team is a crucial part of how Zen will help both transform the supply and recruitment experience for schools and generate the savings the education system needs. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to apply themselves for a great cause and with great responsibility and autonomy to shape our product and development for years to come. We're looking for talented engineer looking to take their skills to the next level by joining a growing, high-performing product delivery team in an agile environment. You'll be:
• Picking up, owning and deploying new features from scratch, working closely with front-end developers
• Reviewing PRs and helping us improve our ways of working
• Investigating and tackling new challenges and responding to bugs
• Writing high quality, well-tested code

What You’ll Bring
• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails (6yrs+)
• Experience refactoring legacy code and considering trade-offs around technical debt - A top performer that wants to be part of a high-performing, motivated team
• Growth mindset — dedicated to growing your skills as a professional
• Passion for work with a positive social impact
